name: Filkemp (FILKEMP - Industria de Filamentos S.A.)
summary: Portuguese industrial polymer and nylon monofilament maker based near Lisbon. It sells a consumer 3D-printing line, 3DFilkemp, with PLA, the PLN line, PETG, nylon and nylon-CF, distributed in the UK by Additive-X and GoPrint3D.

product_lines.name: PLN
product_lines.notes: Described in the notes as a PLA-type line, marketed by Fabbaloo as a 'high-performance sustainable' filament; the exact chemistry is not documented.

additional_notes: Appears to extrude its own material; no catalog OEM relationship found. UK distribution through Additive-X (authorised distributor) and GoPrint3D. An Additive-X listing titles Filkemp PETG as '3D Print Master Pro', which may be a reseller name; the relationship is not verified beyond that listing. A secondary search summary claims Filkemp was founded in Germany in 1952, moved to Portugal in 1969, went through an MBO in 1998, and runs about 23 lines at ~5,000 t/yr; none of this is verified. Ships from Lisbon. Has Facebook, Instagram and YouTube presences (URLs not captured). No price evidence, so price_tier is omitted.

provenance.conflicts: Company history (1952 German founding, 1969 move, 1998 MBO, capacity) is from an unverified secondary summary. Legal name comes from a search-result listing on the Portuguese transparency portal.
